Digit Three Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Digit Three is 51. Hold Alt, type 51 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Digit Three also has the Unicode codepoint U+0033, so you can type it with Alt+51 on Windows, search for U+0033 in macOS's Character Viewer, use 3 in HTML, or \0033 in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Digit Three character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. Digit Three has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape 3 or the hex escape 3.

How to type digit three on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 5 1 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Digit Three character (3) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type digit three on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Digit Three. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Digit Three" and click the character to insert it.

How to use digit three in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\0033"; ()
  • Python: \u0033 or chr(0x33)
  • JavaScript: \u0033 or String.fromCodePoint(0x33)
  • JSON: "\u0033"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Digit Three?

The legacy Alt code for Digit Three is 51. Hold Alt, type 5 1 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type 3 without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as 3, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+51 not work?

Alt+51 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Digit Three?

The Unicode codepoint for Digit Three is U+0033. You can use this value in HTML as 3, in CSS as \0033, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type 3 on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+0033, then click it.
